title: S158 shipped with broken unit test + missing sprint JSON on main
summary:
Two process / coverage issues in S158 (voice synth v2, PR #198) discovered by running the full unit suite on origin/main (HEAD 5f86701):

1. **1/1778 unit test fails**: `examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/voice-synth.test.ts:87` — `PHRASE_PATCHES (S110) > pickup + victory are rising contours; death is falling; place-bomb is flat`. The old assertion was `expect(death[death.length - 1]!).toBeLessThan(death[0]!)` — i.e. the multi-syllable death contour ends lower than it starts. S158 redesigned death to a SINGLE-syllable shape with intra-syllable falling slide via the new `pitchEndContour` field: `death: { pitchContour: [0.95], pitchEndContour: [0.35], ... }`. The array has length 1, so `death[0] === death[length-1] === 0.95` and `0.95 < 0.95` is false. The test wasn't updated for the new design — it should now assert that `pitchEndContour[0] < pitchContour[0]` instead (or check both arrays). pickup/victory cases pass because they're still multi-syllable rising.

2. **`backlog/sprints/S158.sprint.json` is missing from origin/main**. PR #198 was tagged S158 in its commit title but no sprint JSON file landed. Everything from S150-S157 has a sprint JSON; S158 is the first gap. Likely the dev forgot to commit the file along with the code changes. `npm run backlog:check` may or may not warn depending on how strictly it requires a sprint JSON per merged sprint-labelled PR.
repro: Run `npx vitest run examples/kaboom-crew/tests/unit/voice-synth.test.ts` — 1 failed / 18 passed (19 total).
Inspect the failing case body at lines 80-90 — assertion expects array-encoded falling contour for death which no longer exists.
Run `git ls-tree -r origin/main backlog/sprints/ | grep S158` → returns nothing. S150-S157 all present.
Run the full suite `npx vitest run tests/unit examples/kaboom-crew/tests examples/procbomber-bench/tests` to confirm: 1 failed / 1777 passed (1778 total).
expected: The merged PR should ship green on `npm run test`. Either update the failing test to assert the new intra-syllable slide (e.g. `expect(PHRASE_PATCHES.death.pitchEndContour[0]).toBeLessThan(PHRASE_PATCHES.death.pitchContour[0])`) OR keep an array-shape contour for death that satisfies the old assertion. Plus: commit `backlog/sprints/S158.sprint.json` so the backlog tracks the work — every other sprint has one.
actual: Test fails because the array `death.pitchContour` collapsed from length>=2 (falling) to length 1 (single value). The new falling shape now lives in `pitchEndContour`, but the test still reads the old array. Sprint JSON is missing entirely — discoverability via `engine:doctor`'s Backlog section + `npm run qa:next-pr` keys off the sprint JSON; without one S158 is invisible in those views.
